text:
Maria: Heads-up — the cu12 image canary we rolled an hour ago is causing a provisioning spike. Provisioner shows a lot of nodes stuck in REBUILD and some containers failing to start due to rpath/ld cache mismatches.
Devin: Seeing increased NCCL timeouts on startup too, rendezvous failing between pods (timeout during process group init).
Chris: Is this regional?
Maria: Mostly ap-southeast-1 and a smaller cluster in us-west-2. eu-west-1 looks fine so far.
Samir: Provisioner metrics: reprovisioning rate jumped to 43% for cu12 label, cost burn up ~18% this hour from retries.
Lia: Any quick rollback option?
Maria: We can rollback canary to cu11 images (already queued) but we need the root cause before re-enabling cu12.
Devin: Root logs show dynamic loader complaints: "failed to load /usr/local/cuda-12/lib64/libcuda.so.1 (wrong ELF class/soname mismatch)" and also DT_RUNPATH entries pointing to absolute host paths that don't exist in container.
Chris: That smells like image build embedding host driver paths into RPATH. Different container toolchain (gcc13 in CI) may be setting DT_RUNPATH.
Maria: Agreed. Also found kernel dmesg on a couple nodes: "nvidia_uvm: unresolved symbol: some_host_symbol" — likely driver/kernel module ABI skew on some hosts where driver is older than container expects.
Devin: Quick check commands we used:
```
# from failing node/container
ldd /usr/local/bin/my_inference_binary | grep -E 'cuda|nvidia'
readelf -d /usr/local/bin/my_inference_binary | grep RUNPATH
```
If RUNPATH points to /var/lib/nvidia/driver-XXX that's the problem.
Samir: Temp mitigation: scaled provisioner concurrency 20 -> 5 to dampen thundering herd and reduce retries. Also added tag to prevent scheduler from placing cu12 pods on known old-driver hosts.
provisioner-bot: provisioner: scaled concurrency from 20 to 5; quarantined 12 hosts with older driver packages.
Lia: Long term: we should add an image lint that fails builds if DT_RUNPATH contains absolute host paths or references /usr/local/nvidia. Add a preflight that runs ldd against critical binaries.
Devin: Also recommend building a small driver-shim into the image: copy the minimal libcuda stubs and set RUNPATH to $ORIGIN/../lib so we avoid absolute host paths. Example Dockerfile snippet: 
```Dockerfile
FROM ubuntu:22.04
COPY driver-shim/libcuda.so.1 /opt/driver-shim/lib/
ENV LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/opt/driver-shim/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
# ensure rpath is relative during link: -Wl,-rpath,$ORIGIN/../lib
```
Maria: Good. We should also gate canary to 10 nodes and run a preflight that verifies: ldd binary OK, readelf RUNPATH check, and modprobe nvidia modules present on node.
Chris: Note: some bare-metal pools boot with older kernel headers — we saw "tainted module" lines. Need kernel package inventory by region before re-enabling.
Samir: Opened INFRA-4512 to track image-rebuild + lint + gated canary. Rolling back canary now.
Maria: I'll coordinate a rebuild pipeline that enforces relative RUNPATH and runs the ldd/readelf checks. After rebuild, run canary 10 nodes in eu then ap then us.
Lia: Add a cost watch alert for reprovisioning rate > 10% so we catch regressions faster.
provisioner-bot: action: rolled back canary tag cu12->cu11 at 2624682400.
Samir: For postmortem: capture list of affected hosts, driver versions, and image build toolchain (gcc version). Suspect gcc13 change in CI altered linker defaults.
Maria: TL;DR: rollback done, mitigation pinned, image lint + shim + gated canary next.
Devin: Thanks — I'll start the CI patch for rpath flags and add readelf check to image tests.
Chris: I'll inventory kernel/driver versions in ap-southeast-1 and us-west-2 and mark incompatible hosts.
Samir: Noted — cost alert and INFRA-4512 updated with links. :thumbsup:
